annotations.title: What Meta has pushed to Hermoso

description: The Page events Meta has PUSHED to Hermoso — new comments, mentions, lead-form submissions and inbound Messenger/Instagram DMs — each with the moment it arrived. This is the difference between a brand learning about a comment when someone thinks to look and learning about it when it happens. Scoped to the Pages this profile can actually see, so it never shows another account’s activity. AN EMPTY FEED IS AMBIGUOUS AND THE REPLY SAYS SO: nothing has happened, or the Page is not subscribed (check meta_webhook_status — an unsubscribed Page is silent and looks exactly like a quiet one), or Hermoso restarted and rebuilt the feed from its durable mirror, which keeps recent deliveries rather than all history. Read-only, 0 credits.
